title: Servamp
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Mahiru Shirota takes in a stray black cat that turns out to be Sleepy Ash, one of seven vampire 'Servamps' named for the Seven Deadly Sins (his is Sloth). By naming him Kuro and giving him blood, Mahiru becomes his master, or 'Eve'. When Tsubaki, a vampire claiming to be a hidden eighth brother, declares war on the other Servamps, Mahiru sets out to unite them against him.
life_message: A good life means getting involved: caring for others, taking responsibility and building bonds instead of keeping a safe distance.
